newsitem.title: ESTONIA: MAAPANK SHARE ISSUE OVERSUBSCRIBED THREE TIMES.
newsitem.headline: MAAPANK SHARE ISSUE OVERSUBSCRIBED THREE TIMES.

text.p: Maapank, the seventh largest bank in Estonia, said on Monday that its 51.5 million kroon share issue was oversubscribed three times.
"The issue was oversubscribed three times and we are very happy with the results," Kalev Raidjoe, the chairman of the bank's board, told Reuters.
"The final results of the share issue will be determined on June 18," Raidjoe added.
The share issue closed on June 12 and attracted interest from the European Bank of Reconstruction and Development (EBRD), which took a 24 million kroon stake and the U.S. backed Baltic Fund.
The bank will hold its board meeting on June 18 and will discuss the bank's future strategy.
"One of the big items for the board at the meeting will be to seek future lines of credit and a listing on the bourse," Raidjoe added.
